_instructions: This file configures TLS certificate pinning for the FishMMO client launcher. Pins are SHA-256 hashes of the SubjectPublicKeyInfo (SPKI) DER encoding, base64-encoded — the same format used by HPKP / RFC 7469. SPKI pinning survives certificate renewals as long as the key pair is reused. Always configure at least two pins (active + backup) so an emergency key rotation does not require a client patch.
_generate_pins: To generate a pin from a PEM certificate: openssl x509 -in cert.pem -pubkey -noout | openssl pkey -pubin -outform der | openssl dgst -sha256 -binary | openssl base64. Or use FishMMO > Security > Fetch Certificate Pins in the Unity Editor.
_deployment_notes: Place this file in the StreamingAssets/ directory of the Unity project. At build time, Unity copies StreamingAssets into the build output. ClientSecurityBootstrap reads this file during client startup. Field name must be allowOnEmpty (not allowOnEmptyPins) — JsonUtility maps exact C# field names only.
_pinning_status: Active pin is the SPKI observed from the live leaf certificate. Keep a second pin for rotation whenever you mint a backup key.
